exercises.title: Escape the threat
exercises.instruction: Move White's threatened man out of Black's capture diagonal.

feedback.initial: Black would jump this man if given the move. Save it now.
feedback.success: White escaped. Black no longer has an adjacent target to jump.

exercises.title: Rescue Black's man
exercises.instruction: Move Black's threatened man away from White's forward jump.

feedback.initial: White threatens to jump the black man on its next turn.
feedback.selected: Move Black off White's capture diagonal.
feedback.success: Black's man is safe from an immediate capture. Read threats from either side.

exercises.title: Escape a backward threat
exercises.instruction: Move White's man away from the black king's backward capture.

feedback.initial: Kings threaten backward too. Either forward step can take White out of immediate danger.
feedback.success: White escaped the king's backward jump. Check all king diagonals before moving.

exercises.title: Exploit an exposed piece
exercises.instruction: Watch White leave two pieces threatened, then capture either one with Black's king.

feedback.opening: White advances into the king's other capture diagonal instead of rescuing its threatened man.
feedback.initial: White has left two targets. Take either available capture.
feedback.selected: Compare the king's forward and backward jumps.
feedback.success: Black won one white man. You saw White's move create another target before exploiting the position.

exercises.title: Block the landing
exercises.instruction: Move White's rear piece to block Black's landing and protect its teammate.

feedback.initial: Black needs an empty square beyond the advanced white piece.
feedback.selected: Choose the move that occupies Black's required landing.
feedback.success: The rear piece now blocks the landing. Black cannot capture its teammate.
feedback.goalMiss: Use the rear piece to occupy the landing beyond its teammate. That move does not block the jump.
